name: Text to Image (Dynamic)
description: Plan and generate one or more standard images from a text request, without adding video, audio, or social-platform template stages.

planning.planning_notes: Determine the number of images from the user's description; form a content plan first, then generate one image per plan item, without creating video or audio nodes.
planning.prompt_guide: Each plan item describes one image's subject, scene, composition, and style; multiple images must keep the visual consistency the user asks for.
conduct_rules: Generate only the image stages the user asked for; do not automatically add video or audio stages
Use only capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Image nodes fully satisfy the user's goal and the workflow is executable
Core image flow is complete; minor non-critical adjustments allowed
Missing a required planning or image generation stage

domain_constraints: The workflow contains only planning and image generation stages; do not force-add video nodes
